title: Application Launcher's username requires a reboot in order to change fonts
line: The username in the Application Launcher now switches to a new system font right away, without restarting.
explanation: Kirigami's Heading sets font.pointSize and font.weight on top of the style's Label, and a sub-property binding in a derived type replaces the base's binding on the whole font. So a Heading got the application font once at creation and never followed later font changes; Kickoff's username label lives as long as plasmashell, so it kept the old family until restart. The change also binds font.family to the theme's default font, so every Heading follows font family changes live.

commits.message:
Heading: follow the theme's font family

Setting font.pointSize and font.weight overrides the style's binding on
the whole font, so a Heading kept the family it had when it was created
and ignored later font changes until restart. Bind the family as well.

BUG: 519494

     id: heading
 
+    font.family: Platform.Theme.defaultFont.family

       let factor = 1;
       switch (heading.level) {
